description: Development model-selection evaluation comparing original_language, augmented_language, and anchored_language on States 23-32.

tasks.notes: Strictly 10 new development states (23-32). States 0-2 (historic dev) and 3-22 (consumed test) strictly excluded. States 33-52 (confirmatory) strictly untouched.

execution.worker_isolation: Serial execution (1 worker) is mandatory to eliminate concurrent rendering non-determinism.

model_selection_rule.role: Frozen development model-selection gate (pre-registered prior to rollout execution)

definitions.O: success rate on the original instruction across States 23-32 (denominator = 10)
definitions.P: pooled success rate across paraphrase_dev_01 and paraphrase_dev_02 (denominator = 20)
definitions.H: balanced robustness-retention score: 2 * O * P / (O + P) if (O + P) > 0 else 0.0

model_selection_rule.notes: anchored_language passes development gate only if ALL three conditions hold. This is a development/model-selection rule, NOT a statistical significance claim.
